---
title: "Gumbel Distribution"
author: "Anthony Morciglio"
date: "10/30/2025"
output: html_document
---

```{r, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
if(!require(extraDistr)) install.packages("extraDistr", repos="http://cran.us.r-project.org")
if(!require(ggplot2)) install.packages("ggplot2", repos="http://cran.us.r-project.org")

library(extraDistr)
library(ggplot2)

# Parameters for the Gumbel Distribution
mu <- 0      # location
beta <- 1    # scale

# Create a sequence of x values
x <- seq(-5, 10, length.out = 300)

# Compute PDF and CDF
pdf_vals <- dgumbel(x, mu, beta)
cdf_vals <- pgumbel(x, mu, beta)

# Compute expected value (mean) and median
expected_value <- mu + beta * 0.5772  # Euler-Mascheroni constant ≈ 0.5772
median_value <- mu - beta * log(log(2))

# Combine into a data frame for ggplot
df <- data.frame(x, pdf_vals, cdf_vals)

# Plot PDF
pdf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, pdf_vals)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = expected_value, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_value, color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gumbel Distribution - PDF",
       subtitle = paste("Location =", mu, ", Scale =", beta),
       x = "x", y = "Density") +
  annotate("text", x = expected_value + 0.3, y = max(pdf_vals)*0.8, label = "Mean", color = "red", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = median_value + 0.3, y = max(pdf_vals)*0.7, label = "Median", color = "darkgreen", hjust = 0) +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot CDF
cdf_plot <- ggplot(df, aes(x, cdf_vals)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = expected_value, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_value, color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gumbel Distribution - CDF",
       subtitle = paste("Location =", mu, ", Scale =", beta),
       x = "x", y = "Cumulative Probability") +
  annotate("text", x = expected_value + 0.3, y = 0.6, label = "Mean", color = "red", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = median_value + 0.3, y = 0.5, label = "Median", color = "darkgreen", hjust = 0) +
  theme_minimal()

# Display both plots
print(pdf_plot)
print(cdf_plot)
```
